correctness.rationale: In the 8-dimensional Hall basis x,y,z,u,v,a,b,c with the stated six brackets, central quotient by <Aa+Bb+Cc> is seven-dimensional. For nonzero leading x/y pair, images in grades 2,3 and quotient degree 4 give adjoint rank 3 exactly on zeros of Q_K(s,t)=At²-Bst+Cs² and otherwise rank 4. The grade-3 and grade-4 leading cases give ranks 2 and {1,2}, with central rank0. Each rational projective root supplies q−1 nonzero vector representatives; counting free remaining coefficients gives N0=q², N1=nu(q−1)q², N2=(q−1)q⁴+[q²−1−nu(q−1)]q², N3=nu(q−1)q⁵, N4=[q²−1−nu(q−1)]q⁵. Summing q^(7−rank) centralizers yields stated commuting probability. Sym² PGL2 action on P2 binary quadratics has irreducible, repeated and split types; their projective counts are (q²−q)/2,q+1,q(q+1)/2, valid even in characteristic 2 under alternating brackets. Independently used explicit integer quotient rank elimination for every center line over F2 and F3, recovering all ranks/orbit types and the formula; algebraic argument handles all q.
